# GiftOfy

> GiftOfy is a free website for creating and sharing personalized digital wishes. A sender chooses an occasion and design, writes a message (up to 500 characters) and shares a link; the recipient taps to reveal the wish and can send a private reply. No account is needed by either side. GiftOfy does not sell gifts, process payments, schedule messages or support photo uploads.

Operated by an independent individual (see About). English-language site.

## Product
- [How GiftOfy works](https://giftofy.vercel.app/how-it-works): the create, share, reveal and reply flow, with current limits
- [FAQ](https://giftofy.vercel.app/faq): pricing, accounts, privacy, replies, removing a wish
- [Create a wish](https://giftofy.vercel.app/create)
